answer: A mirror may act only after delivering river, one river being an hour of novel work accepted by three randomly drawn judges. Every accepted output is fingerprinted on the mesa, a public registry of work hashes and payout wallets. Mirrors whose outputs or wallets collide there are pooled, and the pool's k-th mirror must deliver k river before it may act. An honest mirror delivers 1 river, while 1,000 pooled mirrors owe about 500,000 hours of real, uncopyable labour. It breaks if judges are bribed or outputs are paraphrased past the fingerprint.
